name: capture.link
description: A LINK message to the capture account: a live code links the sender to the person who made it (and is used up), a wrong one counts as a try. After five tries in an hour no code is checked. A message answered before (the same Meta message id) changes nothing and says so. Internal: packages/connect's webhook, as the principal META_WEBHOOK_AS names.
sql: with seen as (insert into brandbase.capture_seen (id, account, at) values (:mid, :account, :now::timestamptz) on conflict (id) do nothing returning 1), prior as (select s.tries, s.tries_since from brandbase.capture_senders s where s.account = :account and s.sender = :sender), n as (select case when p.tries_since is null or p.tries_since <= :now::timestamptz - interval '1 hour' then 0 else p.tries end as tries, case when p.tries_since is null or p.tries_since <= :now::timestamptz - interval '1 hour' then :now::timestamptz else p.tries_since end as since from (select 1) one left join prior p on true), c as (delete from brandbase.capture_codes k where k.account = :account and k.code_hash = :codeHash and k.expires_at > :now::timestamptz and exists (select 1 from seen) and (select tries from n) < 5 returning k.user_id, k.name), up as (insert into brandbase.capture_senders as s (account, sender, user_id, name, linked_at, tries, tries_since) select :account, :sender, c.user_id, c.name, case when c.user_id is not null then :now::timestamptz end, case when c.user_id is null then n.tries + 1 else 0 end, n.since from n left join c on true where exists (select 1 from seen) on conflict (account, sender) do update set user_id = coalesce(excluded.user_id, s.user_id), name = coalesce(excluded.name, s.name), linked_at = coalesce(excluded.linked_at, s.linked_at), last_brand = case when excluded.user_id is null or excluded.user_id = s.user_id then s.last_brand end, tries = excluded.tries, tries_since = excluded.tries_since returning 1) select jsonb_build_object('fresh', exists (select 1 from seen), 'linked', (select name from c), 'limited', exists (select 1 from seen) and (select tries from n) >= 5) as result
